name: pilibala
description: Review your team, delegate work and retrieve durable results in Pilibala.

interface.shortDescription: Your persistent team behind your assistant.
interface.longDescription: Use your Pilibala team as yourself. Review tasks, delegate work to agents, add feedback and retrieve documents. Delegation can start autonomous work using your team's configured execution capacity and budget.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review my Pilibala team and show what needs my attention.
